notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary regional interaction subscription-filtering surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies independent ordinary and regional declarations, explicit empty-region no-op behavior, overlap delivery, disjoint suppression, conveyed source-region designators, callback-time re-evaluation after a subscription-region move, ordinary and region-qualified sends, standard region validation failures, and independent region and federation cleanup without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary and regional interaction publication, subscription, unsubscription, send, region mutation, and cleanup services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction delivery
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador regional interaction subscription filtering declarations
